name: Biped Humanoid Robot
summary: ViHero’s Biped Humanoid Robot is the two-legged platform listed in its current product catalog. The official image depicts a humanlike head with a vision module, a torso display, two articulated arms with hands, and jointed legs. ViHero describes its humanoid range as combining multimodal perception, motion control and humanlike movement for assistance, reception, exhibition explanation and related research. A formal generation number and current delivery terms have not been verified.
